messages:
kat: Quick note  we're co-hosting a demo + partner podcast segment with SignalForge next Thursday 11:00am PT. Format: 8m partner story, 20m live integration demo, 10m quick-fire Q&A. Can we run a 25m tech + media dry-run Wed 3:30pm?

omar: I can do Wed 3:30. I'll check marketplace provisioning, OIDC redirect, and the short-lived demo token. Also need to confirm we can record the session (partner ok with recording?).

felix: Partner gave recording consent. I'll manage audio checks and presspack visuals. Swag update: 90 press kits (sticker set, lapel pin, one tee). 20 kits to EU; declared value $24/kit for customs. Courier ETA day-of 07:30; on-site pack 08:00.

hannah: Tech notes: SignalForge will call our hosted endpoint and wants a fallback to Dedicated when latency > 200ms. Also they embed an iframe for code snippets; please confirm CORS allowlist. Can we provide a transient demo token (6h) and a scoped webhook for provisioning events?

kat: Omar, paste their redirect URI so I can whitelist it on staging. Also need a 2-line cue card for the host about fallback messaging.

omar: Redirect URI: https://studio.signalforge.io/oauth/callback. Added to staging allowlist and created demo token demo-sf-182500 (6h TTL). Will DM speaker at 10:50am day-of.

felix: Courier-bot, confirm manifest include customs forms and that tracking numbers will be posted by 20:00.

courier-bot: Pickup scheduled Wed 18:00 local. Manifest and customs forms uploaded to drive. Tracking numbers to be posted by 20:00. :package:

hannah: Quick staging smoke for fallback test (use demo token on staging):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-sf-182500' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-mini","prompt":"podcast preflight","max_tokens":12,"simulate_load":true}'
```
Expect initial route to hosted then fallback to `redwood-dedicated-eu` when simulate_load:true triggers. Watch `routing-decisions` stream.

ops-bot: Dry-run reminder scheduled Wed 15:10 (1824989400). I will ping this channel 20 minutes before. :bell:

kat: Dry-run agenda (Wed 3:30pm, 25m):
- 15:30 start + quick intros (3m)
- 15:33 audio & recording test (5m)
- 15:38 OIDC & token smoke (5m)
- 15:43 induce hosted->dedicated fallback & observe logs (7m)
- 15:50 final cue card + presspack QA (5m)

felix: Volunteer for on-site kit QA at 8:15am day-of: I'll cover it. Also sharing presspack insert PDF to the drive by EOD.

kat: Thanks all. If no blockers we'll lock the runbook after the dry-run. :sparkles:
